leah_pr: PR/Press: we want UTC embargo times and a DO NOT SHARE list from each vendor. Also request a short embargo-safe line for social if leaks happen.
vendor_bot: Calendar: "Vendor GPU Wave - Embargo & SI" created. Link: https://calendar.example.com/event/2143670001. Staging: s3://partners/2143670001 (ACL pending).

- H100/H200/B200: 2026-06-05 09:00 UTC -> 2026-06-05 15:00 UTC
- MI300: 2026-06-12 09:00 UTC -> 2026-06-12 15:00 UTC
- Gaudi: rolling 2026-06-20 -> 2026-06-26 (APAC gating)
mike_ops: CI snippet I'll share to validate SHA on merge. If vendors include driver metadata we can reduce SI cert window to 36h.
